name: New Run or RunOnce autorun value
description: A new watched Run/RunOnce value was observed after the baseline. Registry writer is unknown.

name: Autorun references a user-writable path
description: A new or changed autorun references an explicit executable in a commonly user-writable path. Path location is a heuristic, not an ACL check. Writer PID remains unknown.

name: Auto-start service references a user-writable path
description: A new or changed auto-start service references a commonly user-writable executable path. Automatic start alone is not suspicious; Registry writer is unknown.
